newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal finmin sees budget deficit 2 pct GDP '99.
newsitem.headline: Portugal finmin sees budget deficit 2 pct GDP '99.

text.p: Portuguese Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco said he expected Portugal's budget deficit to drop to two percent of Gross Domestic Product in 1999.

"The Finance Ministry will deliver to the European Union (in March) the convergence plan for the three-year period from 1997-1999, which should include a budget deficit of two percent of GDP at the end of 1999," Sousa Franco told reporters after a meeting with MPs in parliament. -- Lisbon newsroom +351-1-3538254
